column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.12.2019

III. 
Stuffed  vegetables  should  be  kept  in  well  ventilated,  adequate  lighting,  no  room  for  rats,  or  in  any
other room or refrigerator or cooler room.
A food processing point should be a place where cooking food or raw food can be kept vertical and horizontal.
A place where food is intended to be distributed free of charge or served for any promotional purpose should
not be a food hazard.
The place shall be authorized by the Chairman so as not to cause any public obstruction or to cause any public
disturbance
It should be a temporary or permanent building designed to provide adequate space so that all operations can
be carried out satisfactorily.
The adjacent jar should be kept in place and garbage containers should be kept in such a way that flies or other
insects cannot enter.
In the event that the Pradeshiya Sabha intends to operate a free food place in an area not covered by the Solid
Waste Management Service, a license must not be issued unless the applicant has established a formal waste
disposal system as specified by the Medical Officer, Public Health Inspector.
It is the duty of the Licensee to ensure that employees wear the same hats at all times when they are employed,
in order to ensure that every employee engaged in the preparation of meals at the Licensed Place.
Provide  clean  water,  clean  towels  and  hand  washing  soap  or  lotion  to  everyone  working  in  the  licensed
premises.
Any infection, contact or skin disease caused by the Licensee or any recently suffered from such disease or any
person who has recently undergone treatment for a person or a person suffering from any such disease, unless
the  period  of  infection  and  spermatogenesis  has  expired,  free  delivery  of  food  for  a  licensed  promotional
purpose, or the provision or distribution of free food for any purpose, or to be employed or assisted or assisted
in any work by any such  person should not engage in free delivery of food
In the place of the free delivery of food for any promotional purpose or place of delivery or distribution of free
food  any animal should not be kept
Toilets  and  breeding  areas  should  be  kept  separate  from  food  consumption  sites  and  should  not  be  opened
directly to food handling areas.
No person shall be allowed to engage in any kind of work where the food is distributed or served free of charge
for a licensed promotional purpose unless the person is well-washed and in good personal hygiene.
The  time  it  takes  for  an authorized  officer  to  comply  with the  terms  of  this  by-law  means any  time  the  free
delivery or presentation is made, or any food product being processed.
Under this by-law, it shall be the duty of the Licensee to assist in inspecting the premises where food is served
or served free of charge for any promotional purpose authorized by an authorized officer and shall not interfere
with such activities.
Any  complaint  about  places  where  food  is  distributed  or  served  free  of  charge  for  licensed  promotional
purposes may be made in writing or orally to the Chairman, Secretary or Authorized Officers and it shall be
lawful for such officers to conduct a formal investigation.
Any violation of one or more of the provisions of this by-law is an offense.
A  person  authorized  by  the  Chairman,  the  Medical  Officer  of  Health  or  the  Public  Health  Inspector  or  the
Chairman to act on or under any circumstance may seek to act without a permit under Section 3 above. It is
lawful for a notice to be terminated by a written notice.
